notes.title: Work From Home Update
notes.content:
[h1]Work From Home Update[/h1]

In the spirit of social distancing Corporate America has been updated to allow you to play alone now as well as with friends. Along with this update are bug fixes and map tweaks to optimize your play.

[h2]Action Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added bots!
[*]Major bug fixes
[*]Some minor map updates based on player feedback
[/list]

-HR
